questions.prompt: The prompt stays the same for 3 turns. How many system/message events does logSystemPrompt write?
options: One, because it appends only when the text changes
None, because the prompt goes in the system field
questions.explanation: logSystemPrompt compares the text with the latest system/message and appends only when they differ. The first turn writes it; the next two write nothing.

questions.prompt: You rebuild a request from turn 1 after the prompt changed in turn 3. Which prompt does requestFrom put in the system field?
options: The turn 1 prompt, because only events up to that moment are read
The turn 3 prompt, because it is the newest
No prompt, because system/message makes no message
questions.explanation: Rebuilding uses the events that existed at that moment. The only system/message then was the turn 1 prompt, so that is the prompt the request had.

questions.prompt: What goes wrong if the prompt stays a constant passed beside the session?
options: Old requests cannot be rebuilt, because the session does not show which prompt they used
The session gets a gap in its sequence numbers
questions.explanation: After the constant changes, nothing in the session says what the earlier requests contained. The prompt is model-visible, so it must be logged.
